title: Spiced Chickpea and Tomato Stuffed Aubergines
summary: Soft roasted aubergines filled with a warmly spiced chickpea and tomato mixture, finished with herbs and lemon. It’s a comforting Middle Eastern-style vegan dinner that’s hearty enough on its own or with flatbread and salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray with parchment or lightly oil it.
Slice the aubergines in half lengthways and score the flesh in a crosshatch pattern without cutting through the skin. Brush with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and season lightly with salt.
Place the aubergines cut-side up on the tray and roast for 25 to 30 minutes, until the flesh is soft and lightly golden.

Meanwhile, heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika and chilli flakes and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the chickpeas, canned tomatoes and tomato paste. Season with salt and black pepper, then simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened.
Once the aubergines are tender, gently scoop out some of the flesh, leaving a sturdy shell. Chop the scooped flesh and stir it into the chickpea mixture.
Spoon the filling into the aubergine shells and return them to the oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until hot through and slightly browned on top.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley, then serve hot.
